source_title: CMS Rural Health Transformation award announcement
direct_observation: CMS announced 50 state awards under a 50 billion dollar five-year program; 10 billion dollars available each year from 2026 through 2030; first-year awards average 200 million dollars and range from 147 million to 281 million
missing_stage: local intervention spending staffing appointment access continuity and outcome
next_test: select a named state and trace award to county service line

source_title: GAO Rural Health Transformation implementation and monitoring report
direct_observation: GAO reports 10 billion dollars awarded to 50 states in year one; CMS plans progress discussions information review audits and site visits; up to 40 billion dollars remains conditional on satisfactory progress
missing_stage: actual implementation spending delivery workforce and patient results
evidence_status: official GAO report; implementation plan not outcome
next_test: match one state milestone to public spend staffing and service data

source_title: HRSA State of the U.S. Health Care Workforce 2025
unit_or_scope: US population and health professional shortage areas
direct_observation: As of December 2 2025 about 92 million people lived in a primary care HPSA 64 million in a dental HPSA and 137 million in a mental health HPSA; rural maldistribution is severe
missing_stage: program-attributable change named rural service and patient outcome
next_test: compare later HPSA and local workforce data with named program activity

unit_or_scope: metro and nonmetro workforce projections through 2038
direct_observation: HRSA 2023 to 2038 projections report a possible 58 percent physician shortage in nonmetro areas versus 5 percent in metro areas in 2038
missing_stage: actual recruitment retention local appointments and continuity
evidence_status: official HRSA projection; model not realized outcome
next_test: track named rural specialty and retention over time
